Rae: Quick heads-up  our signoff window overlaps heavily with interview travel this week. We have 10 managers pending and ~4 confirmed OOO. Can we decide delegation vs extension?
PeopleOpsBot: Current status: 10 pending, 4 flagged OOO. Export available: signoffs_pending.csv
Omar: I can pick up 3 signoffs tomorrow AM. If we delegate, how do we surface that in the export so calibration isn't confused?
Jules: Add columns: delegated_by, delegated_reviewer, and reviewer_role=delegate. That way calibration packet can filter.
Priya: Also ask delegates to prefix calibration notes with "DELEGATED:" and include original manager brief context (1-2 bullets).
Rae: Vote: if >8 delegations we'll push deadline 48h; else we'll assign backups and keep timeline. Managers please reply with "out:dates" in thread.
Omar: out: Thu-Fri (onsite interviews) — I'll take two on Fri AM.
Jules: out: Thu — delegated to Priya (she's aware).
Priya: Confirmed. I'll update forms to mark delegated reviewer and add context bullets.
PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled in 90 minutes for outstanding manager signoffs.
Rae: Thanks all. I'll tally and post final plan in 2 hours. If we extend, I'll publish the revised timeline and update calibration leads.
